snippet.title: Xenonauts 2 - 1.0 Launch Trailer | Turn-Based Tactical Alien Invasion
snippet.description:
Wage a global war of resistance against an alien invasion. Command turn-based tactical battles, build a network of covert bases, directly control your fighter wings, and achieve strategic victory in a simulation of asymmetric warfare against a technologically superior foe. 

Xenonauts 2 1.0 is out now on Steam, GOG, and Epic!

➤ STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/538030/Xenonauts_2/
➤ GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/xenonauts_2
➤ EPIC: https://store.epicgames.com/p/xenonauts-2-42a236
